summary: The Fulton County Public Library urges the FCC to maintain E‑Rate funding, arguing that cuts would devastate library services and community access to broadband.

claims.argument: Cutting E‑Rate would force the library to reduce core services, limiting community access to essential digital resources.
claims.evidence_quote: reliable internet access year after year because of E-Rate. Many libraries in Indiana are already facing substantial budget cuts within the next few years, so a cut to E-Rate would be devastating.

filer_raw: Andrea Roe | Fulton County Public Library
